items.body:
Bumps the codeql-actions group with 2 updates: [github/codeql-action/init](https://github.com/github/codeql-action) and [github/codeql-action/analyze](https://github.com/github/codeql-action). Updates `github/codeql-action/init` from 4.39.1 to 4.39.2
Release notes

Sourced from github/codeql-action/init's releases.

v4.39.2

  • Update default CodeQL bundle version to 2.27.4. #4284
  • Upcoming breaking change: CodeQL version 2.22.3 and earlier were discontinued on 16 October 2026 alongside GitHub Enterprise Server 3.18, and will be unsupported by the next minor release of the CodeQL Action. Added a deprecation warning for customers using these versions of CodeQL. #4266
  • Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, traced analyses are unsupported. See this blog post for more information. The CodeQL Action will now try to identify if a workflow is about to perform a traced analysis on version 27 or above of macOS or Xcode. If so, the CodeQL Action will emit a corresponding warning that will also be visible on the Tool Status Page. This check will be rolled out following this release of the CodeQL Action. #4221
  • The undocumented TRAP cache cleanup feature that could be enabled using the CODEQL_ACTION_CLEANUP_TRAP_CACHES environment variable has been removed, as announced in the release notes for CodeQL Action 4.35.2. The analyze Action now warns if this environment variable is set. If you used TRAP cache cleanup to limit Actions cache usage, we recommend disabling TRAP caching by passing the trap-caching: false input to the init Action. #4243
Changelog

Sourced from github/codeql-action/init's changelog.

CodeQL Action Changelog

See the releases page for the relevant changes to the CodeQL CLI and language packs.

[UNRELEASED]

No user facing changes.

4.39.3 - 04 Nov 2026

  • Fixed diff-informed alert filtering incorrectly removing alerts in changed files whose paths contain spaces, special characters, or non-ASCII characters. #4283

  • Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, traced analyses are unsupported. See this blog post for more information. The CodeQL Action will now try to identify if a workflow is about to perform a traced analysis on version 27 or above of macOS or Xcode. If so, the CodeQL Action will emit a corresponding warning that will also be visible on the Tool Status Page. This check will be rolled out following this release of the CodeQL Action. #4221
  • The undocumented TRAP cache cleanup feature that could be enabled using the CODEQL_ACTION_CLEANUP_TRAP_CACHES environment variable has been removed, as announced in the release notes for CodeQL Action 4.35.2. The analyze Action now warns if this environment variable is set. If you used TRAP cache cleanup to limit Actions cache usage, we recommend disabling TRAP caching by passing the trap-caching: false input to the init Action. #4243

4.39.1 - 21 Oct 2026

  • Update default CodeQL bundle version to 2.27.3. #4256

4.39.0 - 15 Oct 2026

  • Breaking change: Bump the minimum required CodeQL bundle version to 2.20.7. #4205
  • The codeql-action/analyze step now validates that a correct argument for the checkout_path input has been provided. The checkout_path input must be set to the path where the repository that is being analyzed is checked out at on the runner, if that path is something other than the workspace root. If the path does not point to a repository checkout or is different from the path that was used by codeql-action/init, then the CodeQL Action now produces a warning. #4148
  • Resolved an issue with third-party caching implementations that prevented caches from being restored correctly. #4206
  • The codeql-action/start-proxy step that is used in Code Scanning Default Setup now finds CodeQL releases using the same logic as codeql-action/init. This primarily benefits customers who are using GitHub instances other than github.com where the codeql-action/start-proxy step may previously have been unable to locate recent releases and ended up using outdated versions of the private registry authentication proxy as a result. #4198

4.38.3 - 08 Oct 2026

  • Upcoming breaking change: CodeQL version 2.21.2 and earlier were discontinued on 24 September 2026 alongside GitHub Enterprise Server 3.17, and will be unsupported by the next minor release of the CodeQL Action. Added a deprecation warning for customers using these versions of CodeQL. #4188
  • Update default CodeQL bundle version to 2.27.2. #4203
  • Fixed a bug where the decision of whether to use a per-language bundle did not account for custom configurations that reference queries outside of compiled CodeQL packs. This issue was caught during internal testing and did not affect any customer repositories. We will resume the roll out of per-language bundles in the coming weeks. #4184

4.38.2 - 24 Sept 2026

  • Update default CodeQL bundle version to 2.27.1. #4160

4.38.1 - 18 Sept 2026

  • The CodeQL Action now has experimental support for CodeQL releases for which per-language bundles are available. Per-language bundles support analysis for a single language and are therefore smaller than the combined bundles that allow analysis for all supported languages. As a result, per-language bundles take up less space on disk and are faster to download. We expect to roll this change out to everyone in the coming weeks. #4146

4.38.0 - 09 Sept 2026

  • On GitHub-hosted runners, the CodeQL Action now deletes unused CodeQL bundles from the toolcache before downloading a different bundle, which frees up disk space for the analysis. We expect to roll this change out to everyone in September. #4124
  • The CodeQL Action now supports CodeQL releases that are compatible with Linux Arm64 and downloads the native linux-arm64 CodeQL bundle when available. #4072
  • Update default CodeQL bundle version to 2.27.0. #4129

items.body:
Bumps [github.com/itchyny/gojq](https://github.com/itchyny/gojq) from 0.12.19 to 0.12.20.
Release notes

Sourced from github.com/itchyny/gojq's releases.

Release v0.12.20

  • implement gojq.ToInt and gojq.ToFloat64 for converting number values
  • fix destructuring alternative operator (?//) to reset variables of later alternatives, and to propagate break and halt errors
  • fix update-assignment operator against object with overlapping paths
  • fix delpaths function to delete ancestor paths before descendant paths
  • fix getpath function against string input
  • fix indexing and slicing a number literal written after a unary operator
  • fix slice indices of floating point numbers for jq compatibility
  • fix date and time functions against fractional, non-finite, and out of range numbers
  • fix strptime function to accept the zero time instant
  • fix match, test, and capture functions to support array arguments
  • fix match function to report an empty match after a non-empty one
  • fix split/1 function against empty input string
  • fix math functions against large number literals like 1e1000
  • fix jn/2 and yn/2 functions to avoid long recurrence on large orders
  • fix abs function against non-numbers for jq compatibility
  • fix isnan function to return false for non-numbers for jq compatibility
  • fix halt_error function not to print a newline after non-string values
  • fix --argjson and --jsonargs options to reject empty and multiple JSON values
  • fix --stream option error message against unterminated input
  • fix JSON parse error message after a large value in non-seekable input like stdin
  • fix offset of YAML parse error on multi-byte characters
  • fix panic on continuing iteration after an invalid path error
  • fix data race on input iterator when running code concurrently
  • fix add function to handle a nil map and slice as the first value
  • support destructuring alternative operator (?//) in reduce and foreach syntax
  • allow optional operator followed by alternative operator without spaces (.a?//1)
  • improve performance of function calls by avoiding copies of scope values, and path tracking in path, paths, |=, and del by reducing allocations
